SELECT YEAR(c.start_date) AS 年份, COUNT(DISTINCT c.conference_id) AS 会议数, COUNT(p.country_id) AS 参与国次, COUNT(DISTINCT c.host_country_id) AS 举办地国家数 FROM conference c LEFT JOIN conference_participant p ON p.conference_id = c.conference_id GROUP BY YEAR(c.start_date) ORDER BY 年份

SELECT cn.country_id AS 国家编号, cn.name_cn AS 国家 FROM country cn WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM conference_participant p WHERE p.country_id = (SELECT country_id FROM country WHERE iso_code = 'CHN') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM conference_participant x WHERE x.conference_id = p.conference_id AND x.country_id = cn.country_id ) ) ORDER BY cn.country_id
SELECT user_role AS 角色, COUNT(*) AS 人数, SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 启用人数, COUNT(DISTINCT country_id) AS 涉及国家数 FROM app_user GROUP BY user_role ORDER BY 人数 DESC
